violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint. Food employee found without a hair restraint. Hair should be restrained when working with food. ***Corrected during inspection.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Granola scoop found in granola with handle in granola. Scoop handles should remain out of food being served.
